scope: Existing full native RGB64 / SlotPerception / persistent visual memory / decoder / calibrated R2 identity; known synthetic development populations only.
limits: Known development populations; no sealed-test or new-kind claim.
Native slot is lossy; full pyramid is re-encoded from retained lossless frame.
No fine-detail, pose/operator-transfer, natural-image or full-agent learning claim.
Seven relocation misses remain; cross-layout lamp accuracy has the same counts.
Other historical surrogate rerun families remain open.
corrections: Surrogate DetailCodec limitations do not establish a main-architecture limitation; prior scoped surrogate measurements preserved.
Proxy cosine screen demoted prospectively before new calibration/evaluation; actual task gates unchanged.
Invalid OOD pose diagnostic preserved and replaced by in-domain diagnostic; centroid failure does not prove absent information.
Fine TRAIN grid exposed a calibration search gap, but joint3000 still failed one of six populations. Joint6000 selected legacy-grid .90; success did not depend on finer points.
Unused confusable augmentation removed only after no-augmentation candidate qualified; both failed versions preserved in Git and runs.
Single-point final-source confirmation is linked to original full16-policy TRAIN selection, not represented as fresh selection.
